path_step: Course creation service or database is unavailable
test_scenario: Verify system handles course creation failure when the service or database is unavailable.
test_case_title: Verify Course Creation Fails with System Unavailable Error
pre_condition: The user is logged in as a Teacher and navigates to the new course creation page. The course creation service or database is simulated to be unavailable.
expected_result: A generic error message, 'Course creation service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.', is displayed. The Teacher remains on the new course page, and no new course is created. A critical error is logged in the system.
post_condition: The system logs a critical error, the course creation attempt is unsuccessful, and the system displays an appropriate error message to the user.

test_steps.step: Simulate the course creation service or database being unavailable.
Enter a valid course title, image URL, and course information into the respective fields.
Verify that the error message 'Course creation service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.' is displayed on the new course page.
Verify that the Teacher remains on the new course page.
Verify that no new course titled 'Unavailable Service Test Course' has been created in the database.
Disable the simulation of service unavailability to restore normal system operation.

test_data_fields.field_value: This course is for testing system unavailability during creation.

uncovered_conditions: E1: System Unavailable - If the course creation service or database is unavailable at step 6
System logs the critical error during service unavailability
System displays a generic error message (e.g., 'Course creation service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.')
Teacher remains on the new course page upon system unavailability
